title: Toll Holdback on Credit Refunds after Turn-In, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Toll Billing Schedule — Holdback on Credit Refunds for Recently Turned-In Units, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Rule.** For the refund of a credit balance on a turned-in unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the refund toll holdback is $250 where the unit was turned in 60 or fewer days before today and is titled in a state on Kestrel's toll-authority billing list (California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia and Washington), $100 where it was turned in 60 or fewer days before today and is titled in any other state, and nothing where it was turned in more than 60 days before today.

**Records read.** The unit's turn-in date and its title state. Days run from the turn-in date to today and count the later date but not the earlier one.

## Toll-authority billing list

California (CA), Colorado (CO), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Illinois (IL), New Jersey (NJ), New York (NY), North Carolina (NC), Ohio (OH), Pennsylvania (PA), Texas (TX), Virginia (VA), Washington (WA).

## Holdback table

| Days from turn-in date to today | Title state | Toll holdback |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or fewer | on the list | $250 |
| 60 or fewer | any other state | $100 |
| more than 60 | any | nothing |

## Both sides of the window (hypothetical, unit titled in Ohio)

- Turned in on day 0, today day 60: 60 days, $250.
- Today day 61: 61 days, nothing.
- The same timing for a unit titled in Arizona: $100 on day 60, nothing on day 61.
